vectors.name: dst-gap-snooze-maps-on-the-pre-transition-offset-not-yet
vectors.why: Sun 2026-03-08: Chicago skips from 02:00 CST to 03:00 CDT at 08:00Z, so the wall time 02:30 never happens. It maps on the pre-transition offset (CST, UTC-6), as fold=0 / timeutil does: 08:30Z. At 08:15Z (03:15 CDT, quiet hours) the snooze has not ended. The post-transition offset would give 07:30Z and reopen too early.

vectors.name: dst-fall-back-snooze-uses-the-earlier-instant
vectors.why: Sun 2026-11-01: 01:00-01:59 happens twice (CDT, then CST from 07:00Z). An ambiguous wall time means its earlier instant: 01:30 = 06:30Z (CDT). At 06:45Z (01:45 CDT, the first pass, quiet hours) the snooze has ended: reopen. The later instant (07:30Z, CST) would not have reopened yet.
